title: Forge — keep the maker's line
source_passage: Old Sena worked the bellows and studied her phone for the time. The forge glowed like the beating heart of some vast and patient god. 'A blade remembers every hand that holds it,' she told the boy. She wiped her brow with the back of her hand. She wiped her brow with the back of her hand again. The apprentice watched the sparks climb.
user_context: Please revise. The line she tells the boy is the whole point of the chapter — do not change a word of it.
